skill.name: database-admin
skill.description: Provides database administration guidance for cloud platforms, automation, reliability, security, performance, backup, recovery, and cost management.
skill.summary: Plan reliable, secure, and efficient database operations across cloud and self-managed platforms.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive caused by Markdown backticks around a document path. The skill contains guidance only and shows no executable command or malicious intent.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 24 uses Markdown inline-code formatting for the path `resources/implementation-playbook.md`. It contains no Ruby expression, shell invocation, or executable command.

content.value_statement: Complex database operations create reliability, security, and cost risks. This skill provides structured guidance for architecture, automation, monitoring, recovery, and optimization.
actual_capabilities: Designs database architectures for AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, and self-managed platforms.
Creates high availability, backup, recovery, replication, and failover plans.
Recommends monitoring, alerting, query analysis, connection pooling, and capacity practices.
Plans database security controls, encryption, auditing, access management, and compliance procedures.
Guides schema migration, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and GitOps workflows.
Evaluates database costs, sizing, storage, reserved capacity, and workload placement.
limitations: It does not connect to databases, cloud accounts, monitoring systems, or secret stores.
Recommendations require validation against the actual engine, version, workload, and provider configuration.
It cannot guarantee compliance, recovery objectives, performance gains, or production safety.
Execution steps may require privileged access and approval from database, security, and platform owners.

use_cases.title: Plan a Production Database
use_cases.description: Define architecture, availability, security, monitoring, backups, and capacity for a new production workload.

use_cases.title: Improve Database Reliability
use_cases.description: Assess failure risks and create practical replication, failover, recovery, and observability improvements.

use_cases.title: Control Database Costs
use_cases.description: Review utilization, storage, scaling, and purchasing options while preserving service objectives.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Health Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a daily health checklist for [database engine] covering availability, backups, replication, connections, storage, and alerts.

prompt_templates.title: Review Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this [database engine] performance issue using these metrics: [metrics]. Identify likely causes, checks, changes, risks, and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design Disaster Recovery
prompt_templates.prompt: Design disaster recovery for [workload] with RPO [value] and RTO [value]. Include replication, backups, failover, testing, ownership, and rollback.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Multi-Cloud Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan migration from [source] to [target] for [workload]. Address compatibility, security, synchronization, cutover, rollback, observability, cost, and acceptance criteria.

output_examples.input: Design backup and recovery for PostgreSQL with a 15-minute RPO and two-hour RTO.
output: Use continuous write-ahead log archiving with daily encrypted base backups.
Store copies in a separate region and account with tested retention controls.
Run monthly point-in-time recovery exercises and record achieved recovery times.

output_examples.input: Investigate rising connection latency on a managed MySQL database.
output: Compare active connections, wait events, CPU, memory, storage latency, and pool saturation.
Check recent deployments, long transactions, lock contention, DNS, and network changes.
Apply one reversible change at a time and compare results against the baseline.

output_examples.input: Reduce database costs without breaking service objectives.
output: Measure peak and sustained utilization before changing instance size.
Review idle replicas, storage growth, backup retention, data transfer, and licensing.
Test proposed changes under representative load and retain a rollback path.

best_practices: Provide the database engine, version, topology, workload profile, service objectives, constraints, and recent changes.
Test backups, failovers, migrations, and configuration changes in a representative non-production environment.
Require approval, observability, rollback procedures, and clear ownership before production changes.
anti_patterns: Do not apply generic tuning values without measuring workload behavior and resource limits.
Do not perform destructive maintenance or migrations without verified backups and rollback procedures.
Do not share credentials, private data, connection strings, or unrestricted production access.

faq.question: Which database platforms does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers major relational, NoSQL, distributed, time-series, graph, search, warehouse, and managed cloud database platforms.

faq.question: Can it make changes to my database?
faq.answer: No. It provides plans, checks, and recommendations but does not connect to or modify systems.

faq.question: Can it help with outages?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide symptoms, topology, recent changes, metrics, logs, and safety constraints for a structured response.

faq.question: Does it guarantee regulatory compliance?
faq.answer: No. Compliance guidance requires review by qualified security, legal, and audit stakeholders.

faq.question: What information improves performance advice?
faq.answer: Include engine version, schema, query plans, workload patterns, wait events, resource metrics, configuration, and service objectives.

faq.question: How should production recommendations be applied?
faq.answer: Validate them in a representative environment, secure approval, monitor defined metrics, and prepare a tested rollback procedure.
